blink: Blink slowly and fully, with a gentle squeeze each time.
look-far: Look at something at least six metres, about twenty feet, away, such as out of a window.
side-to-side: Keep your head still. Look slowly to the far left, then the far right.
up-down: Keep your head still. Look slowly up, then down.
circle-left: Keep your head still. Slowly trace a big circle with your eyes, counter-clockwise.
circle-right: Keep your head still. Slowly trace a big circle with your eyes, clockwise.
palming: Rub your palms together to warm them. Cup them gently over your closed eyes, without pressing.
walk: Stand up, stretch and walk around.
eyes-closed-rest: Rest with your eyes gently closed.
